title: Database Migration Compiler
description: Formal compiler for database migrations. Reads schema-artifact.json as source of truth, produces verified up/down SQL with rollback guarantee, idempotency, and FK index coverage.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Read schema-artifact.json + description to produce migration-spec.json: table name, columns with SQL types, indexes, foreign keys, version

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate up.sql and down.sql stubs from migration-spec.json

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full up.sql (CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE) and down.sql (complete rollback)

pipeline.title: Safety Check
pipeline.description: Verify rollback completeness, no destructive ops without flag, idempotency guards

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Structural checks: PK not nullable, FK columns indexed, version sequential, contract compliance

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce migration-artifact.json consumed by api-route cross-migration gate

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: migration-spec.json has required fields: version, name, table, operation, columns[]

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: Table columns align with schema-artifact.json fields. Schema is the source of truth — no column without a schema field, no schema field without a column.

gates.title: Up Migration Valid
gates.description: up.sql is syntactically valid SQL with CREATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE. Has column definitions with explicit types.

gates.title: Down Migration Valid
gates.description: down.sql exists and contains the inverse operation of up.sql (DROP TABLE for CREATE TABLE, etc.)

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/PLACEHOLDER in migration SQL files

gates.title: No Destructive Ops
gates.description: No DROP TABLE, DROP COLUMN, TRUNCATE unless spec.allowDestructive: true. ALTER TABLE ... DROP is always gated.

gates.title: Idempotent
gates.description: CREATE TABLE uses IF NOT EXISTS. DROP TABLE uses IF EXISTS. ALTER TABLE checks column existence.

gates.title: Rollback Complete
gates.description: Every operation in up.sql has a corresponding inverse in down.sql. No orphan operations.

gates.title: PK Not Nullable
gates.description: Primary key column(s) are NOT NULL. Nullable PKs are forbidden.

gates.title: FK Columns Indexed
gates.description: Every foreign key column has a corresponding CREATE INDEX. Unindexed FKs cause full table scans.

gates.title: Version Sequential
gates.description: Migration version is a zero-padded integer (e.g. 001, 002). Version does not conflict with existing migrations in the feature.

gates.title: Migration Contract
gates.description: Migration matches migration.contract.json: naming convention, timestamp columns, audit columns

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled database migrations

error_codes.DM002: Migration columns conflict with schema-artifact fields
error_codes.DM007: Migration not idempotent (missing IF NOT EXISTS / IF EXISTS)
error_codes.DM008: up.sql has operations with no inverse in down.sql
error_codes.DM011: Migration version invalid or conflicts with existing
